programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Mad Medicine'. Ever taken medical advice from a cigarette commercial? There was a time when any and all 'cures' could be sold to the public indiscriminately.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: 'S24/E17 - The Pawnerator'. When Rick sets his sights on a rifle from the 1800s, can he take a shot at this deal, or is he off the mark? A seller tries to flex with a signed autobiography by Arnold Schwarzenegger.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: 'S24/E18 - Rarer Than Hen's Teeth'. Rick and Chum show off their pearly whites when a seller brings in a pair of Tyrannosaur teeth. Will they be chomping at the bit or will the deal go extinct?

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E14 - From Dust 'Til Dawn'. The desert country of Mojave, CA, hosts a rough auction where the buyers have to dig deep to find value. Dave hits the action despite his dislike of the area.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E15 - Mexican Grand Off'. The buyers head for San Diego in the hope of finding treasure. Rene and Casey defend their home turf, and Mary hopes to score with a high-end household unit.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E16 - Middle-Aged Mutant Ninja Buyers'. Auctions in Westminster, CA, bring top dollar. Jarrod and Brandi look to hit quick and easy, but the high prices have them taking risks that are no bargain.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E17 - Dreams of Cookies and Cream'. The buyers head to Moreno Valley for auctions at a facility known for great scores. Mary hopes for a solid locker, while Dave is intent on a score of his own.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S6/E9 of 15 - The Foot Artillery Sword'. It's anyone's game when four bladesmiths are tasked with forging blades from old toys using the san mai technique.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S6/E11 of 15 - The Cane Sword'. Four bladesmiths are given a special assignment when they are tasked with forging Doug Marcaida's favorite blade: the Karambit.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S6/E13 of 15 - Napoleon's Sabre'. Four bladesmiths are tasked with creating ladder pattern damascus knives from a real ladder. After they salvage their metal the competitors must go step-by-step to create this intricate design.

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - Beyond Heaven And Hell'. What happens to us after we die? From heaven and hell to resurrection and reincarnation, we'll explore the remarkable possibilities of life after death.

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - Sacred Strongholds'. There are strongholds built to protect the sacred, like an impenetrable wall or a mystical river. But there are others used for more sinister purposes.

programme.title: Queens Of Ancient Egypt
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Queen Tiye'. Investigating the story of Queen Tiye, who rose to dazzling heights 3,300 years ago. Ambitious and stunningly beautiful, Tiye helped Egypt become the greatest nation in the world.

programme.title: Queens Of Ancient Egypt
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - The Other Cleopatra'. The great Cleopatra VII was not the only Egyptian queen to bear that name. Episode 2 explores the shocking story of two other Cleopatras, who ruled Egypt jointly with Ptolemy VIII.

programme.title: Queens Of Ancient Egypt
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Cleopatra's Daughter'. Cleopatra Selene, daughter of Mark Antony and Cleopatra VII. Cleopatra's daughter looked destined for death or obscurity. But she recovered her fortunes to become one of Africa's greatest queens.

programme.title: The Lost Secrets Of Jesus
programme.desc: The Lost Secrets of Jesus is a documentary that peels back the layers of centuries-old tradition and artistic interpretation to reveal the real historical and archaeological evidence behind the life of Jesus.

programme.title: Lost Grail With Alice Roberts
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - The Rosslyn Chapel Mystery'. The claim that the Knights Templar, and the noble Sinclair family, secretly buried the Holy Grail beneath Rosslyn Chapel.

programme.title: Gold Wars Downunder
programme.desc: 'S1/E9'. Donnie and Leigh come face to face in an explosive showdown. At the 1870 mine site, Richie is worried mining manager Dan has lost his mojo.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S17/E6 - Trial By Flood'. As historic high water floods the swamps, Troy puts Pickle to the test, sending her on a grueling solo mission after an all-night hog hunt.

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programme.desc: 'S2/E5 - Famous Finds'. A forgotten manuscript in a dusty trunk. A priceless painting discovered in plain sight. A royal tomb hidden for millennia beneath the sands.

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: 'S7/E7 - Mad Scientists'. Throughout history, there have been men of science who pushed the boundaries of experimentation to the edge of madness. What led these mad scientists down a dark path in their pursuit of knowledge?

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: 'S1/E3 - Delville Wood'. A forest in France, Delville Wood, became the stage for one of the most harrowing battles of World War I. The Battle of Delville Wood was the debut of the South African Brigade on the Western Front.

programme.desc: 'S2/E4 - Uss Monitor, Clash Of The Ironclads'. In the Atlantic, Kevin embarks on a particularly difficult dive. His target: a US Civil War battleship that saved the Northern Navy in 1862: the USS Monitor.
